prose: Mitch Kohl is a creator of orgone technology who gifts his devices to the Earth, in an effort to undo the ongoing damage to the environment from geoengineering, the EMF frequency fence, and overhead chemical spraying. In this show we discuss Reich (who coined the term Orgone), proofs of orgonite's effects, the HAARP program and how it's disguised, chembusters (tech to dissolve chemtrails in the sky), and much more.
